coverage_override.reason: The treated-as clause, summon procedure with its procedure limit, and banishment trigger with its effect limit are three audit units.

effects.printed_clause: This card is always treated as an Aquamarine card.
effects.lua_implementation: The card's archetype/set metadata supplies its Aquamarine identity, and listed_series exposes that relationship to script helpers.

official_references.matched_structure: Relies on database-backed always-treated-as archetype identity rather than a runtime name-changing effect.

effects.printed_clause: If you control a WATER monster, you can Special Summon this card from your GY. You can only Special Summon Aqua Droplet once per turn this way.
effects.lua_implementation: An uncopyable GY EFFECT_SPSUMMON_PROC rejects Necrovalley, requires an open zone and a face-up controlled WATER monster, and uses an oath count for the procedure limit.

official_references.matched_structure: Implements similarly worded GY self-Summoning as EFFECT_SPSUMMON_PROC rather than an activated effect.

effects.issue: Fixed: the GY self-Summon is now a non-activated Special Summon procedure and no longer starts a Chain.

effects.printed_clause: If this card is banished from your GY: You can target 1 Aquamarine Spell/Trap in your GY; shuffle it into the Deck, and if you do, draw 1 card. You can only use this effect once per turn.
effects.lua_implementation: A delayed EVENT_REMOVE trigger checks that this card came from the GY, targets one eligible archetype Spell/Trap under Necrovalley, returns it to the shuffled Deck, and draws only after a successful return; a distinct hard key limits it.

official_references.matched_structure: Triggers on EVENT_REMOVE after the handler was banished from the GY.
Uses an id-keyed hard once-per-turn limit and filtered card processing.
